DCC Kesling Park Ride

Springboro, OH

No-drop

DCC Kesling Park Ride is a road group ride in Springboro, OH. It meets every Thursday, 6:00 pm, starting at Kesling Park, front lot by the basketball court. Expect about 25–30 miles, groups from 12–15 mph up to 19+ mph.

About the DCC Kesling Park Ride group ride

The Dayton club's Thursday road ride south of town. Several pace groups from 12–15 mph up to 19+, all no-drop. Lights required as evenings shorten.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
